description: The file defines the HandlerStack class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, responsible for creating, managing, and executing middleware stacks for HTTP request handling, including methods for creating default stacks, adding/removing middleware, and resolving handlers.

classes.name: HandlerStack
classes.description: Manages a stack of middlewares for handling HTTP requests, enabling the creation of custom handler pipelines for Guzzle HTTP client.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a default handler stack pre-configured with middleware for errors, redirects, cookies, and body preparation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HandlerStack with an optional underlying HTTP handler.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the handler stack as a callable, processing a request with options.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the handler stack for debugging.

methods.name: setHandler
methods.description: Sets the underlying HTTP handler function.

methods.name: hasHandler
methods.description: Checks if a handler has been set.

methods.name: unshift
methods.description: Adds middleware to the bottom of the stack.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds middleware to the top of the stack.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Inserts middleware before a specified existing middleware by name.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Inserts middleware after a specified existing middleware by name.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes middleware from the stack by instance or name.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Composes the middleware stack into a single callable handler for processing requests.
